title: 湖山在望 Hushan Zaiwang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.54 m, eave 3.64 m, ridge 6.71 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 夹镜鸣琴
evidence.excerpt_zh: 别有洞天迤西為夾鏡鳴琴南為聚逺樓東為廣育宫前建坊座後為凝祥殿宫東為南屏晚鐘又東度橋為西山入畫為山容水態夾鏡鳴琴之西為湖山在望為佳山水為洞裏長春（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按夾鏡鳴琴四十景之一額為皇上御書廣育宫奉碧霞元君殿額曰恩光仁照與西山入畫湖山在望佳山水洞裏長春諸額皆世宗御書廣育宫前坊額曰含𢎞光大曰品物咸亨與凝祥殿南屏晩鐘諸額皆皇上御書凝祥殿聫曰茂育恩覃昭聖感資生徳溥配坤元亦御書
evidence.summary: West of 别有洞天: 夾鏡鳴琴, with 聚逺樓, 廣育宫 (to 碧霞元君) and its arch and 凝祥殿, 南屏晚鐘, 西山入畫, 山容水態, 湖山在望, 佳山水 and 洞裏長春.

evidence.title: 湖山在望
evidence.locator: v3 p.57, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-178
evidence.excerpt_zh: 草亭虚敞近湖滨，旷览澄潭玉镜陈。山影印川晴旭叠，波光罨画晚风皴。白云几缕萦峰额，红叶一林绘岸漘。福地豫游蒙圣泽，仙寰驻景小阳春。
evidence.summary: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

evidence.title: 湖山在望
evidence.locator: v3 p.58, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-238
evidence.excerpt_zh: 南北界湖山向背，傍汀移棹境全更。目谋心赏奚同异，有触成因幻想生。山色如如原不动，水含叠叠浪花催。何虚何实强分别，过眼烟云是本来。
evidence.summary: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 湖山在望, 3x1 cells.
